notes.title: Café International released - Playtest is going to end now
notes.content:
Café International is ready for guests

Café International welcomes guests from all countries. The strategic board game is released today and invites players to engage in exciting matches.

We thank the participants of the Playtest for playing. We hope you enjoyed it.

In four weeks we will remove the Playtest version from the Steam library - as Steam has intended. Unfortunately, the leaderboards cannot be transferred, as the finished game is a separate product in Steam.

So let's go storm the leaderboards there!

The finished game is waiting for you here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/965210/Caf_International/

Press and Streamer requests
Press inquiries for Keys please via our press kit page:
https://ashgames.com/press/Cafe_International
or by e-mail to press@ashgames.com

Streamers who like board games and have a Keymailer account can request a key here:
https://www.keymailer.co/g/games/73378

notes.title: Minor improvements
notes.content:
Larger area sensitive to bar dropping
 Improved short tap handling, specifically for MAC touchpad

notes.title: Some minor fixes to make you happier
notes.content:
Prevent switching global leaderboard lists before current list has fully loaded
 Allow animations to finish after resizing game window before adopting new size
